name: TAS2780
description: The `tas2780` platform allows your ESPHome devices to use the Texas Instruments TAS2780 mono Class-D audio amplifier with digital (TDM/I2S) input. This allows the playback of audio via the microcontroller from a range of sources via [Speaker](https://esphome.io/components/speaker/) or [Media Player](https://esphome.io/components/media_player/).

config_entries.label: Address
config_entries.description: The I²C address of the TAS2780. The address is set by the `SD0` pin on the device (see the datasheet). Defaults to `0x38`.

config_entries.label: I2C ID
config_entries.description: The ID of the [I²C bus](https://esphome.io/components/i2c) the TAS2780 is connected to.

config_entries.label: Update Interval
config_entries.description: How often internal error states are logged. Defaults to `5s`.

config_entries.label: Amp Level
config_entries.description: Amplifier output level index. Controls the Class-D output voltage level. Valid range: `0` to `20`, corresponding to approximately 11 dBV to 21 dBV at 48 kSPS (roughly 0.5 dBV per step). Defaults to `8`.

config_entries.label: Channel
config_entries.description: Selects which TDM input channel is played back. Defaults to `mono`.

config_entries.label: Power Mode
config_entries.description: Selects the power supply operating mode. Defaults to `2`.

config_entries.label: Vol Range Max
config_entries.description: Maps the audio_dac 100 % volume level to this fraction of the digital volume scale. Valid range: `0.0` to `1.0`. Defaults to `1.0`.

config_entries.label: Vol Range Min
config_entries.description: Maps the audio_dac 0 % volume level to this fraction of the digital volume scale. Valid range: `0.0` to `1.0`. Defaults to `0.3`. Use this to raise the minimum audible volume and avoid near-silent output at the bottom of the range.
